summary: Completed testing of CraftBolt bug fixes: public upload endpoint and address autocomplete/map features. All 18 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend registration flow tested successfully with address autocomplete and map preview working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Code quality is good - proper separation of concerns with _process_upload helper function
Geocode endpoints properly use httpx async client with appropriate headers
Address autocomplete in RegisterPage.jsx uses useEffect with debounce (400ms) - good pattern
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fixes verified: 1) POST /api/upload/public works without auth for JPEG/PNG/WebP/GIF/BMP formats, 2) GET /api/geocode/search returns Nominatim results limited to Czech Republic, 3) Frontend registration flow (customer/nepodnikatel path) shows address autocomplete dropdown and Leaflet map preview after selection. All tests passing.

public_upload_endpoint.details: POST /api/upload/public accepts JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP without authentication. Rejects invalid formats with 400 error.

geocode_search.details: GET /api/geocode/search?q=Praha returns address suggestions from Nominatim, limited to Czech Republic (countrycodes=cz)

registration_flow.details: 4-step registration (basic → role → account type → details) works correctly for customer/nepodnikatel path

address_autocomplete_ui.details: Typing in address fields triggers autocomplete dropdown with suggestions. Selecting suggestion populates field.

map_preview.details: Leaflet map preview appears after selecting an address suggestion, showing marker at selected location

profile_photo_upload_button.details: Upload button present in registration form, uses /api/upload/public endpoint
